clients.name: Mori Mobile App
clients.description: Native mobile application for iOS and Android. Uses Authorization Code Flow with PKCE (S256) for secure public-client authentication.

clients.name: Mori Backend Services
clients.description: Backend services and internal APIs for Mori. Used for service-to-service authentication and authorization between trusted system components.

clients.name: Mori Web App
clients.description: Web application for Mori users. Uses Authorization Code Flow for browser-based authentication and Direct Access Grants for trusted login scenarios.
